summary: Security and accessibility. (1) FLAG_SECURE on by default: MainActivity and PairingCaptureActivity (camera preview of the one-time QR) add WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE in onCreate, so conversations, diffs, approvals and the QR stay out of screenshots, screen recording and the recents thumbnail. (2) Dark theme and dynamic colour: new ui/theme/Theme.kt ZenpiTheme(dark = isSystemInDarkTheme(), dynamic = true) uses the platform dynamicLight/DarkColorScheme (wallpaper colours; minSdk 31 always has them) and otherwise Zenpi's palette: ZenpiLight (the previous light scheme, unchanged) and a new ZenpiDark (same green/rust hues at dark tones on neutral green-grey surfaces, all surface containers set) that replaces the ZE-519 Material-default dark placeholder. MainActivity uses ZenpiTheme; res/values-night/styles.xml gives a dark window and light status-bar icons. Goldens pin dynamic off (ScreenshotTheme = ZenpiTheme(dynamic = false)). (3) One icon, one function: every reuse of a glyph for different functions was split: deny/allow approval Block/TaskAlt (were the dialogs' Close/Check), paging ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (was ArrowBack/Forward, shared with back navigation, parent directory and tab moves), parent directory ArrowUpward, move tab KeyboardDoubleArrowLeft/Right, terminal keys ^C and arrows as keycap text (were Stop and chevrons shared with stop-message and expand), history readers History (terminal, task, conversation history), sessions Forum, resume session PlayArrow, browse tasks List, open desktop terminal OpenInNew (Terminal stays the page entry), steer AltRoute (was Send), new session AddComment, open/close workspace FolderOpen/FolderOff, add/close directory tab CreateNewFolder/RemoveCircleOutline, add Git worktree CallSplit (AccountTree stays the worktree chip), reload resources Sync, retry request Replay, read full message OpenInFull (like the other readers), model capabilities ToggleOn/Off, Browse host files AttachFile (same palette as the composer's attach). (4) TalkBack: no spoken UUIDs: content descriptions no longer carry request, session, turn, call or worker ids (e.g. 'Cancel message', 'Resume session <name>', 'Allow approval for worktree task'); the id-carrying strings moved to test tags (the IconButton's testTag is the old description, so tests address exactly the same target); visible id texts (request id and digest in the approval sheet, request-id prefixes in message and task statuses, task ids in the task list, unnamed session ids, unknown worktree ids) are shown but spoken as a label or not at all (theme/Accessibility.kt spokenAs = clearAndSetSemantics). Headings: asHeading() (semantics heading()) on the top-bar and page titles, sheet titles (Awaiting approval, Host model, palettes), palette and drawer section labels (Host resources, Desktop commands, Needs you/Running/Idle, Projects, Worktrees), connection section titles and every dialog title. (5) R8: release isMinifyEnabled + isShrinkResources with proguard-android-optimize.txt; no keep rules were needed (Gson is used through its tree model; all dependencies ship consumer rules).

notes: Deviations / decisions: (1) Owned paths are ui/theme/ (new: Theme.kt, Accessibility.kt), res/ (new values-night/styles.xml) and app/build.gradle.kts. Outside them, required by the row: MainActivity.kt and PairingCaptureActivity.kt (FLAG_SECURE, ZenpiTheme); ui/AppShell.kt, ApprovalSheet.kt, Composer.kt, ConversationScreen.kt, DiffScreen.kt, ModelSheet.kt, Palette.kt, SessionToolbar.kt, SessionsScreen.kt, SwitcherDrawer.kt, TasksScreen.kt, TerminalScreen.kt, dialogs/ReaderDialogs.kt, dialogs/SessionDialogs.kt, dialogs/WorkspaceDialogs.kt, nav/SecondaryPage.kt (icons, id-free descriptions, headings); tests: screenshot Portrait.kt (ScreenshotTheme -> ZenpiTheme(dynamic = false), assertAccessibleText) and its 5 suites (UUID fixture ids), ApprovalSheetTest, ConversationScreenTest, new ThemeTest, new androidTest AccessibilityChecksTest, and 9 androidTests whose lookups moved from the id-carrying content description to the identical test tag (ApprovalScreen, Diff, HostPairing, Prompt, SessionCatalog, SessionHost, TranscriptTool, Worker, WorkerStatusPage; ApprovalScreen/Prompt also use the new approval-request, approval-worker-<id> and prompt-request-<id> tags) plus ScannerActivityTest (asserts FLAG_SECURE, then clears it for its screenshot). (2) Validator dependency: Compose enableAccessibilityChecks only exists from Compose 1.8, so the Compose BOM moved 2024.09.03 -> 2025.05.01 (Compose 1.8.2, material3 1.3.2; still compatible with Kotlin 1.9.24 / compiler extension 1.5.14) and the BOM-managed test artifact androidx.compose.ui:ui-test-junit4-accessibility was added as androidTestImplementation (pulls the Accessibility Test Framework). No runtime library was added. The checks are instrumented-only: under Robolectric ATF reports nothing, so they are not part of the JVM gate (the JVM gate carries the UUID/heading contract instead). (3) FLAG_SECURE is unconditional (no user toggle: YAGNI); the pairing fingerprint and the paired Device ID stay readable by TalkBack because the user must compare/copy them (they are host/device key hashes, not UUIDs; PairingScreenTest requires the Device ID text). (4) Dynamic colour is the production default; the goldens use Zenpi's palette so they do not depend on the recording machine. The light palette is unchanged (only primary/secondary/background/surface are set, as before). (5) R8 needed no proguard-rules.pro. (6) Release pairing evidence used a host built from this tree's unchanged Rust (the main checkout's target/release/zenpi predates ZE-516's v=2 invite and fails to pair with either APK), loopback + adb reverse as the harness does, and the emulator joined its virtual Wi-Fi (LAN-first networking refuses cellular-only); Wi-Fi was disabled again and the app uninstalled before the AVD was killed. (7) Not done here: the 13 harness-only instrumented suites (need the Rust validation harness) and the pre-existing SessionScopeScreenTest failure (fails the same on ae2221f).
